increaseAllowance reads and updates msg.sender allowance.
decreaseAllowance reads msg.sender allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is a constructor argument consumed only by the base ERC20 constructor to set _name.
symbol_ is a constructor argument consumed only by the base ERC20 constructor to set _symbol.
decimals_ is only used to initialize the immutable decimals slot in the ERC20Decimals constructor.
initialBalance_ is validated in the constructor and passed directly to _mint.
feeReceiver_ only flows into the ServicePayer constructor as the payable receiver.
serviceName is only forwarded as the argument of the external pay call.
receiver is only used to build the external IPayable call target.
recipient is only used as the credited address inside _transfer.
amount is the primary value manipulated by _transfer for balance arithmetic.
account is only used as the mint beneficiary address.
sender is only used as the debited address inside _transfer.
spender is only used as the allowance key component written by _approve.
owner is only used as the allowance key component written by _approve.
addedValue is only used in the allowance addition of increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is only used in the allowance subtraction of decreaseAllowance.
currentAllowance is a temporary cache of the allowance read and subtracted in transferFrom.
senderBalance is a temporary cache of the balance read and subtracted in _transfer.
accountBalance is a temporary cache of the balance read and subtracted in _burn.
